subject: Request to preserve pilot environment while purchase order clears
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@novamed.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in procurement

Hi Rohan,

Quick note — our evaluation with Redwood has been going well, but our procurement team flagged the PO for additional review yesterday. The legal/finance review looks like it could take another 7–10 business days. Were worried the pilot will hit its usage expiration before the PO clears.

Can Redwood provide a short-term buffer (credits or an extension) to keep the sandbox live while the PO routes? Wed like to avoid restarting tests and losing momentum with engineering. Ive attached the most recent usage snapshot.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Gomez
Head of Engineering, NovaMed Health
(415) 555-0172

Attachment: nova-pilot-usage.csv (summary of API calls and token consumption)

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in procurement

Lisa — thanks for the heads up and for the usage file. Im sorry to hear the PO is delayed; weve seen this block a few times.

Short answer: yes, we can help keep the pilot live. Id like to propose a short "soft-landing" voucher (72 hours of guaranteed tokens plus a one-week trial clock extension) while procurement completes their review. That should be enough for your team to finish the last acceptance runs without interruption.

Ben (cc) handles these approvals — Ben, can you confirm if a small voucher + clock extension is okay under our standard demo policy for DEAL-7892? Kimberly, tagging you so youre aware of the temporary credit request from a finance controls perspective.

If NovaMed can share the procurement contact and a tentative clearance date Ill include that in the voucher note.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.ai

P.S. Let me know if you prefer a short DocuSign approval from NovaMed for an interim voucher or if an email confirmation is sufficient.

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@novamed.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in procurement

Rohan/Lisa — I reviewed the usage and DEAL-7892. Approve a one-time soft-landing voucher: 100k tokens + 7-day clock extension. Policy note: voucher requires an acknowledgement from the customer that PO is in-flight and an expected clearance window. Email confirmation from procurement is fine for this case.

Action items:
- NovaMed: send quick reply from procurement@novamed.com with expected clearance date (email is acceptable).
- Rohan: Ill prepare the voucher and include minimal terms.
- Kimberly: please confirm any billing hold flags; otherwise Ill mark this as standard demo accommodation.

Attachment: soft-landing-voucher-terms.pdf (internal copy)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in procurement

Thanks all — I reviewed DEAL-7892 and the proposed voucher. Finance is OK with the short-term accommodation provided: 100k tokens and 7-day extension. Please include these constraints in the voucher metadata: external PO number (if available), expected clearance date, and a note that usage beyond the voucher will be invoiced if PO is not approved.

Lisa — can procurement reply to this thread with a one-line confirmation of expected clearance date? That will be sufficient for our records and will allow Ben to release the voucher immediately.

Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

---
On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 09:12 AM PST, procurement@novamed.com wrote:
> Hi Kimberly and team,
> We expect final sign-off by 2026-11-12. Will send PO number when routed.
> Cheers,
> NovaMed Procurement
summary: Customer requested a short-term token voucher and trial clock extension because their PO is delayed. Sales proposed a 100k token voucher + 7-day extension; finance approved conditioned on procurements email confirmation of expected clearance date.
